# Version directory names: the shared table of the names a version directory
# under versions/ may and may not have. k3sm (pkg/updater/layout) and
# darwin-net (pkg/netd) each carry a byte-identical copy and test their own
# validator against it, so the two rules cannot drift apart.
#
# One case per line: the verdict (accept or refuse), one space, then the name
# as a Go double-quoted string. Blank lines and lines starting with # are
# ignored.

accept "0.0.0"
accept "1.2.3"
accept "v1.2.3"
accept "v0.2.3"
accept "10.20.30"
accept "v1.2.3-rc.0"
accept "v1.2.3-rc.1"
accept "1.2.3-rc1"
accept "v1.2.3-alpha.beta.1"
accept "v1.2.3-0.3.7"
accept "v1.2.3-x-y-z.--"
accept "v1.2.3+build.5"
accept "v1.2.3-rc.1+build.5"
accept "v1.2.3+20261031"
accept "v0.0.0-20261031120000-abcdef123456"
accept "v1.2.4-0.20261031120000-abcdef123456"
accept "v0.0.0-20261031120000-abcdef123456+dirty"
accept "unknown-0123456789ab"
accept "unknown-abcdefabcdef"
accept "1.2.3-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
refuse ""
refuse "."
refuse ".."
refuse "..."
refuse "/"
refuse "../v1.2.3"
refuse "v1.2.3/.."
refuse "v1.2.3/x"
refuse "/v1.2.3"
refuse "v1.2.3/"
refuse "v1/2/3"
refuse "v1.2.3\\x"
refuse ".v1.2.3"
refuse ".1.2.3"
refuse ".hidden"
refuse ".tmp-v1.2.3"
refuse "v1.2.3.tmp"
refuse "v1.2.3~"
refuse "v1.2.3 "
refuse " v1.2.3"
refuse "v1.2.3\n"
refuse "v1.2.3\u0000"
refuse "v1.2.3\t"
refuse "V1.2.3"
refuse "vv1.2.3"
refuse "v1.2"
refuse "v1"
refuse "1.2.3.4"
refuse "01.2.3"
refuse "1.02.3"
refuse "1.2.03"
refuse "-1.2.3"
refuse "v1.2.3-"
refuse "v1.2.3-rc..1"
refuse "v1.2.3-rc.1."
refuse "v1.2.3-rc_1"
refuse "v1.2.3+"
refuse "v1.2.3+build+5"
refuse "v1.2.3-\u00e9"
refuse "current"
refuse "previous"
refuse "latest"
refuse "unknown"
refuse "unknown-"
refuse "unknown-0123456789a"
refuse "unknown-0123456789abc"
refuse "unknown-0123456789AB"
refuse "unknown-0123456789ag"
refuse "UNKNOWN-0123456789ab"
refuse "v1.2.3unknown-0123456789ab"
refuse "1.2.3-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
